faqs.question: Where is MRU’s agriculture school located?
faqs.answer: The official school page gives Maisammaguda, Dulapally, Hyderabad, Telangana 500100.

faqs.question: What is the published 10+2 marks threshold?
faqs.answer: The eligibility page states at least 50% for the undergraduate agriculture category, with relevant subjects.

faqs.question: What practical components does the school name?
faqs.answer: Its academic-practices page names experiential learning, RAWE, industry training, hands-on work and projects.

faqs.question: Are horticulture and food science also listed?
faqs.answer: Yes, the school lists them alongside agriculture. Their accreditation must be checked separately.

faqs.question: Which degree is covered by this ICAR record?
faqs.answer: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture, with the term 16 March 2026 to 15 March 2031.

faqs.question: Is a current agriculture tuition amount verified?
faqs.answer: No. The official fee page is labelled 2025–26, but its programme amounts were not readable in the source used.

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at MRU?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. The [courses and fees table](/university/malla-reddy-university/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at MRU?
faqs.answer: Official eligibility page states 10+2 or equivalent in relevant subjects with at least 50%; confirm exact subject combinations for the intake.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at MRU?
faqs.answer: A verified numerical fee is not available. An academic-year-specific official fee schedule for this programme was not verified.

faqs.question: How does admission to MRU work?
faqs.answer: MRU publishes separate eligibility and fee pages. Use the agriculture entry conditions and request an intake-specific selection and cost notice before completing the application. Check the agriculture category: Confirm that your subject combination meets the school’s current requirements. Obtain the current programme notice: Request the applicable selection route and the complete B.Sc. Agriculture fee schedule.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for MRU?
faqs.answer: Malla Reddy University: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture (Intake- 240), recorded term 2026-03-16 to 2031-03-15. This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at MRU?
faqs.answer: The school lists experiential learning and Rural Agricultural Work Experience. Its published practices include in-plant/industry attachment, skills training and student projects.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at MRU?
faqs.answer: Genetics and plant breeding laboratory: The official inventory lists seed display boxes, a seed germinator, BOD incubator, hot-air oven, deep freezer and binocular microscope. Plant pathology laboratory: The official school inventory identifies microscopes, hot-air oven, autoclave and incubator. Horticulture and agronomy practical equipment: The school page lists garden tools, sprayers and protected structures including shade nets/polyhouses, alongside tillage implements and agricultural hand tools.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for MRU?
faqs.answer: The school describes experiential learning, rural attachment, industry training, skills work and projects. A detailed current laboratory inventory could not be verified from the linked pages. A readable official school inventory identifies genetics/plant-breeding, plant-pathology, horticulture and agronomy equipment. Confirm present access and practical schedules with the department. Accommodation availability, meal charges and transport arrangements for your entry year still need direct confirmation.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for MRU?
faqs.answer: The official eligibility page states that merit scholarships exist across academic programmes. Agriculture-specific award amounts, score bands and renewal conditions were not verified.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for MRU?
faqs.answer: MRU provides a university placement route, but the agriculture sources used do not establish a dated programme-level employment result. No general-university salary is transferred to the agriculture degree.

faqs.question: How can I contact MRU about an application?
faqs.answer: Published phone: 94971-94971. Published email: admissions@mallareddyuniversity.ac.in. Official admissions: https://www.mallareddyuniversity.ac.in/eligibility-criteria

faqs.question: Which dated admission notices are recorded for MRU?
faqs.answer: No dated admission event is verified in this profile. The official channel is https://www.mallareddyuniversity.ac.in/eligibility-criteria; check the notice for the programme and entry year you intend to join.
